capabilities: Open multiple daily notes in one inline editor page
Filter notes by time range (week, month, year, quarter, custom)
Switch between daily, folder, and tag view modes
Sort notes by creation or modification time
Save presets for quick access to specific folders or tags
extras: The author recommends Make.md as a fuller-featured alternative and links a Buy Me a Coffee donation page.
intentEvidence: which works similar to Roam Research's default daily note view
motivation: The author was inspired by Make.md, which they note works with more features than this plugin.
problem: Obsidian opens each daily note as a separate file, so reviewing or editing notes across several days means switching between many pages.

relations.evidence: I use code from this plugin to generate workspace leaf in my view.
I use code from this api to get all dailynotes and generate daily note.
Make.md: inspired me to create this plugin.

summary: Single-page editor that shows and edits multiple daily notes (or folder/tag note sets) inline, similar to Roam Research's daily note view.
